---
title: "Station Clusters"
---

**Guiding question:** Do stations fall into natural groups by usage pattern: commuter hubs, tourist spots, residential areas
 Does that grouping reveal redundancy or gaps?


- Try to clustering stations by their usage style (time-of-day pattern, weekday/weekend split, seasonality, rider type mix)
- Naming and characterizing the resulting groups (e.g. "downtown commuter," "waterfront/tourist," "residential")
- Whether cluster membership lines up with ward or geography, or cuts across it?
